scope: Real isolated Chromium on macOS; application compiled to JS and WASM, dedicated JS database worker; correctness checks, not throughput benchmarks. Includes query-only relations, CHECK constraints and typed client-default factories with explicit null and prepared batch semantics.

checks.name: memory migrations and verified foreign keys
client factories distinguish omission, explicit null and prepared batch values
generated CHECK enforcement and atomic constraint migrations
generated records, projections and typed relation batches
rollback, savepoints and transaction lifetime
stream cursor batches and early release
commit invalidation and watch snapshots
exact BigInt, Decimal, blobs and calendar transport
explicit unsupported cancellation
large real values retain floating storage
instant microseconds are exact or explicitly rejected
worker does not block the browser event loop
startup failures are bounded and release failed workers
OPFS commit survives a closed worker and new connection
page reload recovers committed rows and rolls back interrupted transaction
persistent schema upgrades after reload preserve existing data
